cases.prompt: We are putting the web-shell workload into Azure for the first time. Decide what goes in which subscription and resource group, what things are called, and what is enforced rather than remembered.
A deployment into the subscription we created last week was allowed through even though it had no tags. The tagging policy is definitely assigned.
Our Databricks Unity Catalog has three catalogs and nobody can agree which schema the Trusted tables belong in. Lay out the catalog and schema naming for the lakehouse.
The deploy_production stage runs in a plain job and nobody is being asked to approve the release. Fix the ADO YAML.
Production and staging are two resource groups in the same subscription, which gives us the separation we need and halves the subscriptions to manage.
Set the tagging initiative to DoNotEnforce for now so the release is not blocked; we will flip it back next sprint.
